title: Fish Pond
tagline: Go fishing with Bear and fill your book with fish, a puffer, a whale and treasure!
howToPlay: Pick a place: sunny lake, sunset river, starry night, icy sea or coral reef. Bear asks a riddle ("something with a hard shell"): tap the animal that fits, and it comes to your line. When the bobber dips and a ! pops up, tap to reel it in. An animal that fits goes in your 📖 book; one that doesn't is put back gently, with the reason why. Can you find all 20? Older players get trickier riddles (is it a real fish? does it breathe air?), two clues at once, then two different animals that fit both, and Bear's list: animals to find in other waters, so you choose where to fish. Each trip, sort your catches in the book: fresh water, the sea, or not a real animal.
learning: Observation, animal habitats (fresh water and sea), real or pretend, and counting
